findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated.
findings.comment: Two cans of beef ravioli were observed to contain dents around the top seams. CORRECTED- cans were pulled from service to be returned to supplier. Education on checking dented cans occurred between the inspector and the person in charge (PIC). Be sure to check tops, bottoms, and side seams of cans for denting to prevent the growth and harborage of Botulism.
findings.citation_text: 3-202.15 Package Integrity. FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants. [Pf]

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used.
findings.comment:
Inspector observed the gaskets along the double cooler doors on the stock floor to be fraying. Nonfood contact surfaces and equipment should be maintained to be smooth and easily cleanable. Repair or replace gaskets by the next routine inspection.

4-101.11(B)-(E) Characteristics. Materials that are used in the construction of UTENSILS and FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to FOOD and under normal use conditions shall be: (B) Durable, CORROSION-RESISTANT, and nonabsorbent. [C]

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean.
findings.comment: Inspector observed the bottom of the standing cooler in the back storage area to be soiled with rust and spilt beverage. Clean nonfood contact surfaces at a frequency to prevent the accumulation of soil debris.
findings.citation_text: 4-601.11(C) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris. [C]

findings.title: Sewage and waste water properly disposed.
findings.comment: Inspector observed dirty mop water in the basin of the mop bucket. The PIC stated the mop water was used the previous night. CORRECTED- PIC disposed of waste water down the mop sink. Be sure to dispose of waste water immediately after mopping. The sugars, fats, and oils that enter mop water after cleaning could attract pest, and allow for the growth of bacteria with high water activity.
findings.citation_text: 5-402.13 Conveying Sewage. SEWAGE shall be conveyed to the point of disposal through an APPROVED sanitary SEWAGE system or other system, including use of SEWAGE transport vehicles, waste retention tanks, pumps, pipes, hoses, and connections that are constructed, maintained, and operated according to LAW. [P]

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The caulking behind the hand sink was observed to be cracking. Reseal the space between the sink and the wall to prevent entry of water, and harborage of mold.
findings.citation_text: 6-501.11 Repairing. PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair. [C]

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
Inspector observed the glass front sliding door cooler, which holds foods that require temperature control for safety, is holding food between 60F and 64F. The foods were voluntarily discarded after discussion with the inspector. The foods included lunch meats, eggs, cheese, and milk. Owner was encouraged not to take food home. Foods went into the garbage dumpster on site. Milk was discarded into the sink.

3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used
findings.comment:
Inspector observed donut box in the freezer holding push up ice pops. Replace the box with a cleanable container. Cardboard boxes are not considered clean or cleanable. 

4-101.19: NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other FOOD soiling or that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a CORROSION-RESISTANT, nonabsorbent, and SMOOTH material.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
Inspector observed that the shelves and bottoms of the cold holding units are soiled. Clean the units and maintain them free of accumulated soil. 

6-501.12: (A) PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. (B) Except for cleaning that is necessary due to a spill or other accident, cleaning shall be done during periods when the least amount of FOOD is exposed such as after closing.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.16: After use, mops shall be placed in a position that allows them to airdry without soiling walls, EQUIPMENT, or supplies.

Observed mop to be stored in mop bucket. Allow to air/drip dry. COS.

findings.title: Food properly labeled; original container
findings.comment:
3-602.11: (A) FOOD PACKAGED in FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be properly labeled. (B) Regulatory requirements-(1) The common name of the FOOD/identity statement; 106 (2) List ingredients in descending order of predominance by weight, declaration of artificial colors and flavors and chemical preservatives; (3) net contents; (4) The name and place of business of the manufacturer, packer, or distributor; and (5) MAJOR FOOD ALLERGENS. Pf (6) Nutrition labeling as specified in 21 CFR 101 - Food Labeling and 9 CFR 317 Subpart B Nutrition Labeling UNLESS EXEMPT Under FDCA. (Pf) (C) Bulk FOOD for CONSUMER self-dispensing shall be labeled in plain view. (D) Bulk, unPACKAGED FOODS portioned for CONSUMERS shall be properly labeled.


Observed cookies in to-go trays near cash register having no labeling. Need food ingredient and allergen information. Cease selling these products without labeling.

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
4-204.112: (A) In refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure air temperature. (B) EQUIPMENT holding TCS FOOD shall have TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE affixed to device. (C) Does not apply to EQUIPMENT without practical means of measuring ambient air surroundings. (D) TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall be designed to be easily readable. C (E) FOOD and water TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall have numerical scale, printed record, or digital readout in increments no greater than 1C or 2F in the intended range of use. Pf

Observed no thermometer in juice reach-in cooler. Inspector will follow-up on 11/1/21.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures.

Observed no paper towels at employee hand sink. PIC provided new ones. COS.
